text: For new files in these examined families, follow nearby accepted names. Address-book privileged modules use names such as VCardUtils.sys.mjs and AddrBookCard.sys.mjs. Paired UI script/markup files use aboutAddressBook.js/.xhtml or changeExpiryDlg.js/.xhtml. Reusable listbox modules use lower-case dashed names such as tree-listbox-mixin.mjs and orderable-tree-listbox.mjs. Classes and mixin factories use UpperCamelCase, such as EnigmailKeyObj and TreeListboxMixin. Preserve the family convention; do not infer one dash-vs-camel rule for the whole tree.
title: Match module and UI filenames to their component family
